column4: The attributes are grouped into relational, moral, foundational, ability categories. Relational attributes describe how we personally experience God. Moral attributes describe His character. Foundational attributes describe His essential nature of being.
column5: Attributes are divided into categories: relational, moral, essential, and abilities. Relational attributes describe how we personally experience God. Moral attributes describe His character. Essential attributes describe His intrinsic nature of being.
